description:
The Kid's 20" 3.0 Trailbreaker E-Bike is set up to not only let your kids enjoy the outdoors on an ebike but also assist them on taking longer rides with you. This 20 inch ebike has the power to climb and the battery range to let your kid keep up on the trails. The 250w hub driven motor delivers throttle-controlled power on demand. It’s durable design and rugged build will provide years of entertainment. With safety in mind we’ve specially designed durable aluminum forged wheels and drum brake with electric motor cut off.

*Recommended for ages 5-10 years old.
*Weight Limit: 120lbs
*Each bike comes with four sets of colored decals

components.description: With front and rear disk brakes, your kids have the ability to safely stop as fast as possible or have a little fun and let the rear tire come to a skidding tail whip. Whichever they want, the dual brakes are for their safety.

With an integrated battery into the frame, we're able to provide a larger capacity then other Kid's ebikes at 24v 10.5aH. It's protected from crashes, falls, and the elements. With an average range of up to 15 miles, you're kids are ready for endless fun!

The Trailbreaker has a 250w motor that has a top speed of around 17mph. Fast enough to give the kids a thrill but slow enough to keep them under control. The Mechanical disk brakes include an activated motor cutoff for quick and easy stopping.

Just like a dirt bike, the Rambo Kid's ebikes delivers throttle-controlled power on demand. With the 20" x 1.95" tires and throttle-controlled power, the Trailbreaker is designed for years of entertainment.
